title: Upper Antagonists
description: Upper-body push-pull supersets: incline push-ups, face pulls and alternating superman

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.instructions: Step up and down from a step, alternating legs

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate arched and rounded back, breathe

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated support, easier variation

exercises.name: Face pulls on the floor
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull backward

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Alternating superman
exercises.instructions: Lift right arm and left leg, alternate

exercises.name: Explosive push-ups
exercises.instructions: Push hard enough for the hands to leave the floor

exercises.name: Inverted row (table)
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull the chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
